generic.Defined scope/population: All open SOX deficiencies from the current testing cycle needing agreed remediation actions
generic.In-scope period: Current SOX testing cycle through the next scheduled testing round
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deficiency ID, action, owner and target date recorded in the AuditBoard tracker
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of actioned deficiencies matches the count of open deficiencies logged
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Owner electronic sign-off and action text retained with an AuditBoard timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputed findings logged with escalation status to the SOX Program Manager
generic.Test population: Every open SOX deficiency in the current testing cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when action, owner and target date are agreed for every open deficiency
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed or overdue actions escalate to the SOX Program Manager for resolution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Process or control owner has electronically signed off on the remediation action
generic.Evidence location: SOX deficiency tracker within AuditBoard

steps.title: Open the SOX deficiency tracker in AuditBoard
sop: Navigate to the SOX module and filter the deficiency tracker to open items.
Confirm the list matches deficiencies noted in current testing workpapers.
Done when the open-deficiency list is filtered and visible.
verify: Check the filtered count against the testing results summary.
Pass when every open deficiency from testing appears in the list.

steps.title: Draft a remediation action for each deficiency with the control owner
sop: Contact the process or control owner named on each deficiency record.
Discuss the exception noted and agree a specific corrective action.
Record the agreed action text in the tracker's remediation field.
Done when every open deficiency has a drafted action.
verify: Read back each drafted action against the original exception.
Pass when the action directly addresses the exception noted.

steps.title: Assign owner and target date in AuditBoard
sop: Enter the accountable owner's name against each deficiency record.
Set the target date to fall within the next scheduled testing round.
Flag any date extension beyond that with a documented rationale.
Done when owner and target date are populated for every record.
verify: Scan the tracker for blank owner or date fields.
Pass when no open deficiency is missing an owner or target date.

steps.title: Cross-reference each action to its testing workpaper exception
sop: Open the source testing workpaper for each deficiency.
Confirm the remediation action maps to the specific test step and exception cited.
Link the workpaper reference in the tracker record.
Done when every action cites its originating test step.
verify: Spot-check three linked records against their workpapers.
Pass when the cited test step and exception match the workpaper.

steps.title: Obtain electronic sign-off from the process or control owner
sop: Route each drafted remediation action to its owner for electronic sign-off in AuditBoard.
Follow up on any record without a response within five business days.
Done when every owner has electronically signed off in the tracker.
verify: Filter the tracker for records missing a sign-off timestamp.
Pass when every open deficiency shows an owner sign-off.

steps.title: Escalate disputed findings to the SOX Program Manager
sop: Identify any deficiency where the owner disputes the finding.
Compile the dispute rationale and supporting workpaper reference.
Route the disputed item to the SOX Program Manager for resolution.
Done when every dispute is escalated with supporting detail.
verify: Confirm the SOX Program Manager has logged a resolution decision.
Pass when no disputed finding remains unresolved.

steps.title: Verify the completed remediation tracker with the SOX Program Manager
sop: Review the full tracker for completeness of action, owner, date and sign-off.
Confirm target dates do not exceed the next testing cycle without rationale.
Approve the tracker as ready for remediation follow-up.
Done when the SOX Program Manager approves the tracker.
verify: Reconcile the approved record count to the open-deficiency count.
Pass when every open deficiency has an approved, complete record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every control failure identified during the current SOX testing cycle requiring severity assessment
generic.In-scope period: Current SOX testing cycle's identified control failures
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Severity rating, magnitude calculation and qualitative rationale in the AuditBoard SOX module
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of severity-rated failures matches the count of control failures logged
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Severity rating and rationale retained with entry timestamp in AuditBoard
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any disputed severity conclusion logged with escalation status
generic.Test population: Every control failure identified in the current SOX testing cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when severity, magnitude and rationale are documented for every control failure
generic.Exception handling path: Contested severity conclusions escalate for SOX Program Manager resolution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: SOX Program Manager concurrence obtained on significant deficiency or material weakness ratings
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard SOX module deficiency severity field

steps.title: Pull the list of control failures from current-cycle testing workpapers
sop: Extract every control failure noted across completed testing workpapers in AuditBoard.
Confirm the extracted list count matches the testing results summary.
Done when every control failure is listed for severity assessment.
verify: Cross-check the extracted list against the testing results summary count.
Pass when no control failure from testing is missing from the list.

steps.title: Apply the severity decision tree to each control failure
sop: Walk each control failure through the deficiency, significant deficiency or material weakness decision tree.
Record the preliminary severity conclusion for each failure.
Done when every control failure has a preliminary severity rating.
verify: Re-trace two ratings through the decision tree independently.
Pass when the recorded rating matches the decision-tree outcome.

steps.title: Quantify misstatement magnitude against the materiality threshold
sop: Calculate the potential misstatement magnitude for each control failure's affected account.
Compare the magnitude to the SOX quantitative materiality threshold.
Record the calculation and comparison result in the assessment workpaper.
Done when every failure has a documented magnitude calculation.
verify: Recompute one magnitude calculation from source figures.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the recorded calculation.

steps.title: Document qualitative severity factors
sop: Note fraud potential, pervasiveness and other qualitative factors for each failure.
Combine qualitative and quantitative factors into a final severity conclusion.
Done when every failure has a documented qualitative rationale.
verify: Confirm the final conclusion reflects both magnitude and qualitative factors.
Pass when the rationale supports the assigned severity rating.

steps.title: Obtain SOX Program Manager concurrence on significant findings
sop: Review every conclusion of significant deficiency or material weakness personally.
Sign off concurrence directly in the AuditBoard SOX module.
Done when every significant conclusion carries a Program Manager sign-off.
verify: Filter the module for significant or material-weakness ratings lacking sign-off.
Pass when none remain unsigned.

steps.title: Update the AuditBoard SOX module with the final rating
sop: Enter the final severity rating and rationale into the deficiency severity field.
Attach the magnitude calculation and qualitative notes as supporting detail.
Done when the module reflects the final rating for every control failure.
verify: Compare the module entries against the assessment workpaper.
Pass when every control failure's module entry matches the workpaper conclusion.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved key control population from the SOX scoping memo for the current cycle
generic.In-scope period: Current SOX testing cycle's design and operating effectiveness rounds
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Control ID, process, testing round and tester name tagged on every result
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of tested controls in AuditBoard reconciles to the approved scoping memo population
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Consolidated results summary saved with version and compile date in AuditBoard
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Controls with no recorded test result flagged before the summary is finalized
generic.Test population: Every key control in the approved SOX scoping memo population
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every in-scope control has a tagged, reconciled pass/fail result
generic.Exception handling path: Untested or missing-result controls are flagged and routed for follow-up testing
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: SOX Program Manager reviews and accepts the consolidated results summary dashboard
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard master testing results summary and Power BI dashboard

steps.title: Export pass/fail results for every tested control from AuditBoard
sop: Run the AuditBoard export covering all key controls tested in the current cycle.
Include control ID, process, testing round and tester name in the export.
Done when the export contains every tested control's result.
verify: Spot-check the export row count against the AuditBoard testing module count.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Reconcile tested-control count to the approved scoping memo population
sop: Compare the exported control list to the approved control population in the scoping memo.
Investigate any variance between tested count and approved count.
Done when the counts reconcile or variances are explained.
verify: Review the variance explanation for each mismatched control.
Pass when every variance has a documented explanation.

steps.title: Consolidate results into the master testing results summary
sop: Load the reconciled export into the master testing results summary workbook.
Tag each row with control ID, process, testing round and tester name.
Done when every tested control appears in the summary with complete tags.
verify: Check a sample of rows for complete tagging.
Pass when no summary row is missing a required tag.

steps.title: Flag controls with no recorded test result
sop: Compare the approved population against the summary to find controls without a result.
Log each untested control for follow-up before finalizing.
Done when every gap is flagged in the summary.
verify: Confirm each flagged control is genuinely absent from AuditBoard's results.
Pass when all missing-result controls are accurately flagged.

steps.title: Produce the results summary dashboard in Power BI
sop: Build or refresh the Power BI dashboard from the consolidated summary data.
Confirm pass/fail counts by process and testing round render correctly.
Done when the dashboard reflects the finalized summary.
verify: Compare dashboard totals to the summary workbook totals.
Pass when the dashboard and workbook totals match.

steps.title: Route the summary dashboard to the SOX Program Manager for review
sop: Review the dashboard for completeness against the approved control population.
Confirm no flagged gap remains unresolved before accepting the summary.
Done when the Program Manager accepts the summary for distribution.
verify: Reconcile the accepted summary's control count to the scoping memo.
Pass when the counts match with no unresolved gaps.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every key control requiring a walkthrough with its process owner this cycle
generic.In-scope period: Current SOX testing cycle prior to design effectiveness assessment
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Walkthrough narrative, trace transaction ID and process owner confirmation recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of walkthroughs completed matches the count of key controls scoped for walkthrough
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Updated narrative and control matrix saved with revision date in AuditBoard
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Design gaps identified during walkthrough logged for design effectiveness follow-up
generic.Test population: Every key control scoped for a process-owner walkthrough
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the narrative is traced through one transaction and owner-confirmed
generic.Exception handling path: Design gaps route to the design effectiveness assessment for evaluation
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Process owner confirms the walkthrough narrative reflects current practice
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard process narrative and control matrix, SharePoint walkthrough notes

steps.title: Schedule the walkthrough session with the process owner
sop: Identify the process owner for each key control step in scope.
Schedule a walkthrough session covering the control end to end.
Done when a walkthrough session is scheduled for every in-scope control.
verify: Check the schedule against the list of in-scope key controls.
Pass when every control has a scheduled session.

steps.title: Conduct the walkthrough and trace one transaction
sop: Walk through the process step by step with the owner during the session.
Trace one live transaction from initiation through to the control point.
Note any deviation between the documented process and observed practice.
Done when the transaction trace is complete for each control.
verify: Review the trace notes for a complete initiation-to-control-point path.
Pass when the transaction trace reaches the control point without gaps.

steps.title: Update the process narrative and control matrix in AuditBoard
sop: Enter any changes identified during the walkthrough into the process narrative.
Update the control matrix entry for the affected key control.
Done when the narrative and matrix reflect the walkthrough findings.
verify: Compare the updated narrative to the walkthrough session notes.
Pass when the narrative matches what was observed.

steps.title: Obtain the process owner's confirmation of the narrative
sop: Send the updated narrative to the process owner for confirmation.
Record the owner's confirmation or requested correction in AuditBoard.
Done when every narrative carries a process owner confirmation.
verify: Filter AuditBoard for narratives missing a confirmation record.
Pass when none remain unconfirmed.

steps.title: Log design gaps for the design effectiveness assessment
sop: Note any control design gap identified during the walkthrough in the tracker.
Cross-reference the gap to the affected control ID.
Done when every identified gap is logged for follow-up.
verify: Confirm each logged gap appears on the design effectiveness assessment intake list.
Pass when no identified gap is missing from that list.

steps.title: Independently review a sample of completed walkthroughs
sop: Select a sample of completed walkthrough narratives across process owners.
Confirm each sampled narrative is confirmed by the owner and traced through a transaction.
Done when the sample review is complete.
verify: Check the sampled narratives for confirmation and trace evidence.
Pass when every sampled walkthrough meets both requirements.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every key control in the approved SOX scoping memo needing a test plan
generic.In-scope period: Upcoming SOX testing cycle calendar
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Sample size, lead tester, target week and pass/fail criteria per control
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Test plan control count matches the approved scoping memo population
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved test plan saved with version and approval date in AuditBoard
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any control lacking a tester assignment flagged before plan approval
generic.Test population: Every key control in the approved scoping memo
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when 100% of the approved population has a plan entry with sample size and tester
generic.Exception handling path: Unassigned or under-sampled controls are corrected before routing for approval
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: SOX Program Manager approves the completed test plan before testing begins
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard test plan calendar and GRC platform control register

steps.title: Pull the approved key control population and PCAOB sampling table
sop: Load the approved control population from the SOX scoping memo.
Reference the PCAOB-aligned sampling table for each control's frequency.
Done when every control has a mapped frequency and sample-size reference.
verify: Check a sample of controls against the sampling table.
Pass when the mapped sample size matches the table for that frequency.

steps.title: Set the attribute sample size for each control in AuditBoard
sop: Enter the sample size for each control based on its frequency in the sampling table.
Record the rationale where a non-standard sample size is applied.
Done when every control has a documented sample size.
verify: Recalculate two sample sizes from the frequency and table.
Pass when the recorded sizes match the recalculation.

steps.title: Assign a lead tester and target week to each control
sop: Assign a named lead tester to each control in the test plan calendar.
Set a target completion week balanced across the testing cycle.
Done when every control has a tester and target week.
verify: Scan the calendar for controls missing a tester or week.
Pass when none remain unassigned.

steps.title: Define test attributes and pass/fail criteria per control
sop: Draft the test attributes to be evaluated for each control's test step.
Define the pass/fail criteria for each attribute.
Done when every control has documented attributes and criteria.
verify: Review a sample of attributes for clarity and testability.
Pass when the sampled attributes are unambiguous and measurable.

steps.title: Confirm the test plan covers the full approved population
sop: Reconcile the test plan's control list against the approved scoping memo.
Resolve any control missing from the plan before routing for approval.
Done when the plan covers 100% of the approved population.
verify: Count the plan's controls against the scoping memo count.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Route the completed test plan for SOX Program Manager approval
sop: Review the completed test plan for sample sizes, attributes and assignments.
Approve the plan in AuditBoard before testing begins.
Done when the Program Manager records approval.
verify: Confirm the approval timestamp precedes the first scheduled test date.
Pass when approval is recorded before testing starts.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every control tested in the current cycle requiring a completed workpaper
generic.In-scope period: Current SOX testing period per the approved test plan
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Test steps, sample items, evidence references and conclusions in the workpaper template
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sample items documented matches the sample size set in the test plan
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Evidence attached per sample item, workpaper saved under standard naming convention
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exceptions noted with sample item ID, nature and initial root cause observation
generic.Test population: Every sample item selected for each tested control
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every sample item has a stated pass/fail conclusion with rationale
generic.Exception handling path: Exceptions are logged in the workpaper and routed to severity assessment
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Workpaper is complete, evidenced and reviewed before filing
generic.Evidence location: SOX evidence folder in AuditBoard/SharePoint under the control ID and period naming convention

steps.title: Open the testing workpaper template for the control in AuditBoard
sop: Select the workpaper template matching the control's test attributes.
Populate the control ID, testing period and tester name header fields.
Done when the template is opened and headers are populated.
verify: Confirm the header fields match the test plan entry for the control.
Pass when control ID and period are correct.

steps.title: Record test steps and sample items performed
sop: List each sample item selected from the population.
Document the test step performed against each sample item.
Done when every sample item has a recorded test step.
verify: Count recorded sample items against the test plan sample size.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Attach underlying evidence for each sample item
sop: Gather approval records, screenshots or reconciliations for each sample item.
Attach the evidence file to its corresponding workpaper row.
Done when every sample item has attached evidence.
verify: Open a sample of attached files to confirm they correspond to the item.
Pass when the sampled evidence matches its workpaper row.

steps.title: State pass/fail conclusions with rationale
sop: Evaluate each sample item against the defined pass/fail attribute.
Write a clear rationale supporting the conclusion.
Done when every sample item has a stated conclusion and rationale.
verify: Check that each conclusion's rationale is consistent with the attached evidence.
Pass when no conclusion contradicts its evidence.

steps.title: Document exceptions with root cause observations
sop: Note the sample item ID and nature of each exception found.
Record an initial root cause observation for each exception.
Done when every exception has an ID, description and root cause note.
verify: Confirm every failed sample item has a corresponding exception entry.
Pass when no failed item is missing an exception record.

steps.title: Save the workpaper under the standard naming convention
sop: Save the completed workpaper to the SOX evidence folder.
Name the file using the correct control ID and testing period convention.
Done when the workpaper is filed correctly.
verify: Check the file name and folder location against the naming convention.
Pass when the file is correctly named and located.

steps.title: Independently review the completed workpaper
sop: Review the workpaper for completeness of sample, evidence and conclusions.
Confirm exceptions are properly documented with root cause notes.
Done when the review confirms the workpaper is complete.
verify: Check the workpaper against the QA completeness checklist.
Pass when every checklist item is satisfied.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every in-scope financial reporting process requiring a documented flowchart
generic.In-scope period: Current SOX cycle's in-scope process list per the scoping memo
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Process steps, systems, control points and control IDs labeled on each flowchart
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Flowchart count matches the number of in-scope processes in the scoping memo
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed flowchart filed with version date in the SOX documentation library
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Handoff points with potential control gaps noted for control matrix follow-up
generic.Test population: Every in-scope financial reporting process
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the flowchart shows every key control point and matches the narrative
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatches between flowchart and narrative are corrected before owner sign-off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Process owner has signed off the flowchart as an accurate representation
generic.Evidence location: SOX documentation library in SharePoint, linked from the AuditBoard control matrix

steps.title: Draft the process flow diagram in SharePoint
sop: Map each processing step, system and control point for the in-scope process.
Use the standard flowcharting template for consistency.
Done when the draft diagram covers the full process end to end.
verify: Walk the diagram against the process narrative for missing steps.
Pass when every narrative step appears on the diagram.

steps.title: Label each key control with its control ID
sop: Reference the SOX control matrix for each key control's ID.
Add the control ID label at the corresponding point on the flowchart.
Done when every key control point carries its control ID.
verify: Cross-check labeled IDs against the control matrix.
Pass when every ID on the flowchart matches the matrix.

steps.title: Identify handoff points with potential control gaps
sop: Mark each system or team handoff point on the flowchart.
Assess whether a control gap could occur at that handoff.
Note any gap for follow-up in the control matrix.
Done when every handoff point is assessed.
verify: Review marked handoffs against the process narrative.
Pass when all handoff points are captured and assessed.

steps.title: Confirm the flowchart matches the control matrix narrative
sop: Compare the flowchart against the narrative description in the control matrix.
Resolve any inconsistency between the two documents.
Done when the flowchart and narrative are aligned.
verify: Check three control points for narrative-to-flowchart consistency.
Pass when no discrepancy remains.

steps.title: Obtain process owner sign-off on the flowchart
sop: Send the finalized flowchart to the process owner for review.
Record the owner's sign-off confirming accuracy.
Done when the flowchart carries a process owner sign-off.
verify: Confirm a sign-off record exists for the flowchart.
Pass when the sign-off is present before filing.

steps.title: File the signed flowchart and confirm SOX Program Manager review
sop: File the signed flowchart in the SOX documentation library.
Review the flowchart for completeness against the in-scope process list.
Done when the Program Manager confirms the flowchart is filed correctly.
verify: Reconcile filed flowcharts against the in-scope process list.
Pass when every in-scope process has a filed, signed flowchart.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every in-scope control requiring a design effectiveness assessment before OE testing
generic.In-scope period: Current SOX cycle, prior to operating effectiveness testing
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Design conclusion, frequency, owner and evidence trail documented per control
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of design assessments matches the in-scope control population
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Design effectiveness workpaper saved with assessment date in AuditBoard
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Controls assessed not designed effectively escalated to the SOX Program Manager
generic.Test population: Every in-scope control from the approved test plan
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every control has a design conclusion before OE testing begins
generic.Exception handling path: Not-effective design conclusions escalate before operating effectiveness testing starts
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Design effectiveness conclusion is documented with supporting rationale in the workpaper
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard design effectiveness assessment workpaper

steps.title: Review the control's design against the assertion it addresses
sop: Evaluate whether the control as designed would prevent or detect a material misstatement.
Reference the control matrix description and process narrative.
Done when the design evaluation is recorded for the control.
verify: Compare the evaluation to the control's stated objective.
Pass when the evaluation directly addresses the objective.

steps.title: Confirm frequency, owner and evidence trail are defined
sop: Check the control has a defined frequency, named owner and evidence trail.
Note any missing element as a design gap.
Done when every control's frequency, owner and evidence trail are confirmed or flagged.
verify: Spot-check three controls for complete frequency, owner and evidence definitions.
Pass when all three elements are present or flagged.

steps.title: Document the design effectiveness conclusion
sop: Record the conclusion as effective, not effective, or needs remediation.
Support the conclusion with the design evaluation notes.
Done when every control has a documented conclusion.
verify: Confirm the conclusion is consistent with the design evaluation notes.
Pass when no conclusion contradicts its supporting notes.

steps.title: Identify compensating controls for any design gap
sop: For each design gap noted, identify a compensating control if one exists.
Assess whether the compensating control sufficiently mitigates the risk.
Done when every design gap has a compensating-control assessment.
verify: Review the compensating control assessment for adequacy.
Pass when the assessment clearly states whether the risk is mitigated.

steps.title: Escalate not-effective design conclusions to the SOX Program Manager
sop: Compile all controls concluded not designed effectively.
Route the list to the SOX Program Manager before operating effectiveness testing begins.
Done when every not-effective conclusion is escalated.
verify: Confirm the SOX Program Manager has acknowledged each escalated control.
Pass when no not-effective conclusion is missing acknowledgment.

steps.title: Independently review the design effectiveness workpapers
sop: Sample completed design effectiveness assessments across in-scope controls.
Confirm each sampled assessment has a supported conclusion.
Done when the review is complete.
verify: Check the sampled conclusions against their supporting evaluation notes.
Pass when every sampled conclusion is adequately supported.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every in-scope control scheduled for operating effectiveness testing this cycle
generic.In-scope period: Current SOX testing period per the approved test plan
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Sample item results, exception rate and OE conclusion per control
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sample items tested matches the sample size set in the test plan
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sample results and re-performance evidence saved in the testing workpaper
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exceptions logged with sample item ID and contribution to the exception rate
generic.Test population: The attribute sample drawn from each control's population
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the exception rate is at or below the tolerable deviation rate
generic.Exception handling path: Controls exceeding the tolerable deviation rate route to deficiency severity assessment
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Overall OE conclusion is documented and consistent with the computed exception rate
generic.Evidence location: AuditBoard operating effectiveness testing workpaper

steps.title: Pull the attribute sample from the control population
sop: Use the sample size set in the test plan to select items from the population.
Confirm the sample selection method matches the documented methodology.
Done when the sample is pulled and recorded.
verify: Recount the pulled sample against the test plan's sample size.
Pass when the counts match.

steps.title: Test each sample item against the pass/fail attributes
sop: Evaluate each sample item against the defined test attributes.
Record the individual pass or fail result per item.
Done when every sample item has a recorded result.
verify: Spot-check three recorded results against the underlying evidence.
Pass when the sampled results match the evidence.

steps.title: Re-perform the control for a sub-sample to corroborate
sop: Select a sub-sample of tested items for independent re-performance.
Recalculate or re-execute the control step for each sub-sample item.
Compare the re-performance outcome to the original tester's result.
Done when the sub-sample re-performance is complete.
verify: Confirm re-performance results match the original tester's conclusions.
Pass when no discrepancy is found in the sub-sample.

steps.title: Compute the exception rate against the tolerable deviation rate
sop: Calculate the exception rate from the sample results.
Compare the computed rate to the tolerable deviation rate in the test plan.
Done when the comparison is recorded.
verify: Recompute the exception rate from the raw sample results.
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the recorded rate.

steps.title: Document the overall operating effectiveness conclusion
sop: Record the control's overall OE conclusion in the testing workpaper.
Ensure the conclusion is consistent with the computed exception rate.
Done when every tested control has a recorded OE conclusion.
verify: Check the conclusion against the exception-rate comparison.
Pass when the conclusion logically follows the rate comparison.

steps.title: Independently review OE testing results
sop: Sample completed OE testing workpapers across the cycle.
Confirm sample results, exception rates and conclusions are consistent.
Done when the independent review is complete.
verify: Check sampled workpapers for consistency between results and conclusion.
Pass when every sampled workpaper is internally consistent.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full-cycle SOX testing results and deficiency inventory for attestation
generic.In-scope period: Current fiscal period's SOX testing cycle through the Audit Committee deadline
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Testing results summary, control matrix and deficiency log as attestation exhibits
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deficiency count in the package matches the count in the AuditBoard deficiency register

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every significant deficiency and material weakness disclosed with remediation status

steps.title: Assemble the CFO/CEO certification package
sop: Compile the summary of testing results, open deficiencies and their severity.
Draft the certification package narrative for CFO/CEO review.
Done when the draft package is assembled.
verify: Check the package summary against the AuditBoard testing results.
Pass when the summary figures match AuditBoard.

steps.title: Attach the control matrix, results summary and deficiency log as exhibits
sop: Attach the completed control matrix as an exhibit.
Attach the testing results summary and unremediated deficiency log.
Done when all three exhibits are attached to the package.
verify: Confirm each exhibit is the current-cycle version.
Pass when all exhibits are current and complete.

steps.title: Confirm every significant deficiency is disclosed with remediation status
sop: Cross-check the deficiency register for every significant deficiency and material weakness.
Confirm each is disclosed in the package with its current remediation status.
Done when every significant item is disclosed.
verify: Reconcile disclosed items against the deficiency register's significant/material items.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Route the package for CFO and management certification sign-off
sop: Submit the completed package to the CFO and management for certification.
Track sign-off status ahead of the Audit Committee deadline.
Done when certification sign-off is obtained.
verify: Confirm the sign-off timestamp precedes the Audit Committee deadline.
Pass when sign-off is recorded on time.

steps.title: File the signed attestation package in the SOX evidence archive
sop: Save the signed package and its exhibits to the SOX evidence archive.
Name and file it under the correct fiscal period folder.
Done when the package is filed correctly.
verify: Confirm the archived package matches the signed version submitted.
Pass when the filed copy is complete and correctly named.

steps.title: Notify the Audit Committee the attestation package is filed
sop: Confirm the filed package location is accessible ahead of the Audit Committee meeting.
Send notification confirming the package is filed and ready for review.
Done when the Audit Committee is notified.
verify: Confirm the notification timestamp precedes the meeting date.
Pass when notification is sent before the meeting.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every significant account and disclosure from the current materiality assessment

steps.title: Update deficiency status at each reporting checkpoint

Update the status field to reflect current progress.

verify: Confirm each status was updated within the current checkpoint window.
Pass when no status is stale beyond one checkpoint.

steps.title: Confirm owner-submitted evidence before marking 'remediated'

verify: Filter for 'remediated' deficiencies missing an evidence attachment.

steps.title: Validate remediation evidence against the original exception

Done when every remediated deficiency's evidence is validated.
verify: Spot-check three validations against their original exceptions.
Pass when the evidence clearly resolves the exception in each case.

steps.title: Move validated deficiencies to closed status
sop: Set the status to validated/closed only after validation is confirmed.

Done when every validated deficiency is marked closed.
verify: Confirm every closed deficiency has a validation date and reviewer recorded.
Pass when none are missing this record.

steps.title: Flag deficiencies past their target closure date

verify: Confirm no overdue deficiency remains unescalated.
Pass when all overdue items show an escalation record.

steps.title: Reconcile closed-deficiency count against Compliance Committee reporting
sop: Count deficiencies marked closed in the tracker for the period.
Compare the count to what was reported to the Compliance Committee.
Done when the counts reconcile.
verify: Investigate any variance between the two counts.
Pass when the counts match or the variance is explained.
